ink-black.$description: Ink Black — Primary text, icon strokes, high-contrast borders — the default for all body, heading, and UI stroke color

paper-white.$description: Paper White — Page canvas, card surfaces, button fills for ghost/outlined controls — the dominant surface tone

soft-mist.$description: Soft Mist — Subtle card surface, secondary panel backgrounds — sits one step above pure white

graphite.$description: Graphite — Muted helper text, secondary labels, de-emphasized metadata

electric-indigo.$description: Electric Indigo — Primary CTA buttons, active nav indicators, brand focal points — the only saturated fill the system uses for action

figma-cyan.$description: Figma Cyan — Figma logo accent, decorative icon highlight — one of the four brand-marker colors in the mark

figma-green.$description: Figma Green — Figma logo accent, decorative icon highlight — second brand-marker in the four-color mark

figma-orange.$description: Figma Orange — Figma logo accent, decorative icon highlight — third brand-marker in the four-color mark

lime-wash.$description: Lime Wash — Decorative illustration fill, playful community-card tint — pastel accent for expressive backgrounds

lilac.$description: Lilac — Decorative illustration fill, pastel accent for expressive backgrounds and tags

blush.$description: Blush — Decorative illustration fill, pastel accent for expressive backgrounds

aqua-mist.$description: Aqua Mist — Decorative illustration fill, pastel accent for expressive backgrounds

earworm-teal.$description: Earworm Teal — Ring stroke, radial highlight accents on decorative graphics — high-energy neon teal

mustard.$description: Mustard — Ring stroke, radial highlight accents on decorative graphics — warm gold companion to teal

figmasans.$description: Primary typeface for all UI. The variable axis spanning 320–700 enables ultra-light display weights for hero headlines (creating whispered authority) up to 700 for bold labels. The custom 'kern' feature and tight negative tracking (-0.02em at 72px) give it a precision-instrument feel. All body, headings, buttons, navigation, and cards use this family.

figmamono.$description: Monospace companion for code snippets, technical labels, and UI annotations. Positive tracking (+0.03em to +0.05em) is deliberate — monospace text breathes wider to read as annotation, not body copy.
